review_boundary: Source-transcription and scope review only; no whole-catalog novelty decision, new experiments, raw specimen reanalysis, independent scientific review or legal clearance.

source.title: Characterisation of mechanical properties of materials used in 3D printing
source.source_record_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) followed by one LF.
source.reuse_decision: No DOI or exact-title match in the baseline sources.json. One new version-qualified source is proposed; concept and version identifiers describe one dataset, not two independent sources.

official_metadata_crosscheck.creator_normalization_limit: Zenodo source-exact names are retained. DataCite transformed name parts differ in ordering; no new person-identity interpretation is needed.

acquisition.metadata_initial_failure: Concept endpoint failed in sandbox DNS before response; its failed attempt is retained. Separate official DataCite concept and Zenodo version requests succeeded with approved network access.

workbook_inspection.method: Installed openpyxl loads with data_only=False and True plus direct stdlib ZIP/XML inspection. No formulas executed or dependencies installed.
workbook_inspection.identity_scope: 'Tested materials'!B10:D28. Printing context E:G was inspected to separate it from reference-filament testing, but is not imported as measured filament conditions.
workbook_inspection.property_scope: 'Tensile modulus'!E6:H24 with original row labels B6:B24, headers E2:H5, and Samples!C4/C27.
workbook_inspection.formula_cache_policy: All selected cells are literal numeric XML values. data_only=True returns the same values; there is no formula/cache dependency to recalculate or trust.
workbook_inspection.numeric_fidelity: Underlying XML numeric strings are retained independently of Excel display rounding; no unit conversion, arithmetic or precision padding in this extraction.
workbook_inspection.row_join_policy: Explicit one-to-one short-name/grade/supplier joins; worksheet row offsets are not assumed. Each measured row has exactly one candidate join.
workbook_inspection.blank_and_zero_distinction: Blank/missing cells are not values. Literal zeros in excluded dog-bone blocks have no explanatory qualification and are not asserted as zero stiffness or zero uncertainty.
workbook_inspection.zero_scope: Koltron (PVDF) O20/P20/T20/U20 and ABS ESD T21/U21 are excluded ambiguous placeholders; no selected reference-filament E:H cell is blank or zero.
missing_other_state_examples: PP single-fibre strength L12:M12 and dog-bone 0-degree strength Q12:R12

mean_basis.limit: The workbook gives a series-level range, not an exact n for each reported row.

avedev.handling: Keep the exact F/H number and MPa unit as a source-labelled deviation note. Do not infer SD, SE, confidence level or an implemented spreadsheet function.

exclusions: printing temperatures and layer thicknesses as reference-filament test conditions

identity_limits: The nineteen worksheet rows are candidates, not nineteen established new compositions. Grade, color, supplier, alias and tested state do not alone establish distinct chemistry.
The source calls CPE co-polyester and nylon polyamide without monomer/subtype; it does not establish equivalence or difference relative to existing PET-G/PA12 entries.
The source labels conductive and ESD products but does not identify additive type/fraction. Independent manufacturer evidence must be kept separate from measured workbook facts.
Do not create extra identities from extruded fibres, dog-bone angles, layer thicknesses, printing recipes or additional properties.

rights_review.license_evidence: Zenodo version metadata.license.id and DataCite concept rightsList agree; DataCite HasVersion points to the exact workbook version.
rights_review.attribution: Aniskevich Andrey; Bulderberga Olga. Characterisation of mechanical properties of materials used in 3D printing. Zenodo, 2023-06-28. Version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089569; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089568.
rights_review.changes_notice: Selected facts are organized into a catalog and qualified by original curation notes; underlying numeric values are unchanged. Only selected source facts and identifiers are retained.

guidance: No scoped AGENTS.md or applicable task skill was found. The existing MATERIAL_REFERENCE_CATALOG.md source/value/identity/rights boundaries were read; final identity admission and root-owned product verification remain separate.
